notes.title: We're moving!
notes.content:
Hello all, it's been a while since I updated you on what's happening here. Last month we were in the middle of renovating our house. This has all been leading to our current situation; we're moving! Moving home was originally something that we had planned to put off for a few more years, but recent events in our lives have meant that our five year plan has become more like a five month plan. As such, a lot of equipment has been packed away, and we're in limbo until our property sells. 

I've always valued transparency when it comes to any of my projects. While this does mean delays, I hope you'll all stick with us until we're in a position to start work on the game again. Cosmic Strike is a passion project and I want to be sure it's an enjoyable, bug-free experience when we finally release out of EA, so rushing it out just to meet a deadline isn't how I want to do things. This game started as a hobby project, and to create a space game that I felt didn't exist, a game that I wanted to play, and I will see that through regardless of how long that might take. 

We have high hopes of things moving quickly so that we can get back to our beloved projects soon, and in between all the chaos, I've made some progress on my programming course, which has some great crafting and gathering code which will build a solid foundation for all current and future games. So, all fingers crossed  we'll be on our way again in no time at all. I'm grateful to everyone who has had faith in Cosmic Strike becoming a fully realised game, and hope you'll stick with us for this new chapter in our lives. Thank you.

notes.title: Cosmicstrike: Early Access Version 3 Coming soon!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Greetings fellow Vanguards![/b][/h1]
For the past 6 months I have been working on a huge reboot of combat, gameplay and game mechanics.

Where to start?!

[h3][b][u]Materials:[/u][/b][/h3]
 Crystals, Gas, Energy cells and Ore have been added to the game. You can collect these from fallen enemies. These new materials can be used to purchase new ships from the research centre. The Black Market has been updated to reflect these changes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541283/1eff31125591f8e562d8e021873ef531a3cd6030.png[/img]


[h3][b][u]Modules:[/u][/b][/h3]
 Will be rebooted  in a future update with new game mechanics where you will be able to equip 6 of the same modules for extra stat bonuses. Or mix and match; the choice is yours!  

[h3][b][u]Elite Vanguard Academy:[/u][/b][/h3]
The same goes for the Academy. This will be re-released once all the elite skills are ready and not just a few like before. 

[h3][b][u]Research Center:[/u][/b][/h3]
 Has been updated and is now more streamlined; the UI will display the amount of each material you will need to unlock the ship, once purchased. It will be followed by a new flashy animation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541283/ed6d33373ee9cc0b7b17f9e51e116841351594c1.png[/img]

[h3][b][u]Shipyard:[/u][/b][/h3]
 All the ships stats have been reworked and the display of this information has been improved with new stats and stat bars. However some information is still a WIP. Some skills will display the wrong amount of damage and some do not display any information at all (all damage is correct in-game). This will be hot-fixed in a future patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541283/c502151769153ee058a3419662cd27d197008643.png[/img]

[h3][b][u]Crew Garrison: [/u][/b][/h3]
 Has been hugely streamlined! You can now recruit and promote crew members here. Crew members have 5 levels of promotion - each promotion affects their major stat; for example a Repair crew member can be promoted from Armour +300 to +450 (+30 armour per level).  Each promotion currently costs 250,000 Credits.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541283/5a36e71ce1f45ddf192e6dc1e0746c3869d3074d.png[/img] 

[h3][b][u]Specializations Complex:[/u][/b][/h3]
A new building where you can choose your own personal Vanguard Specialization. Each  Specialization currently affects 4 of the total 13 different stats! There are currently 12  Specializations, with the possibility of more in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541283/9fe42314177972cbcd5cb917f04cedc3feb9ce4f.png[/img] 

Specialization examples: 
 Is your favourite ship handling too slowly? Then try the 'Space Crusader'! This specialization affects acceleration, angular acceleration, max rotation speed and top speed! 

However, if you want more firepower try the 'Heavy Artillery'. This specialization affects attack power, detection range, precision and critical damage.  

On-top of all of this, each Specialization can be levelled up to a maximum of level 12, Costing 50 Crystals per level. 

[h3][b][u]Armoury:[/u][/b][/h3]
You will enter this new room once you have selected a ship (or clicked the armoury button). Here you will be able to drag and drop your crew/modules into the upgrade slots to improve your ship stats. Your Vanguard Specialization will be applied too. As of writing this all stats are updated in real-time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541283/3cd3862f566eb770b44e943007b91853aebf25a2.png[/img] 

[h3][b][u]Sector map: [/u][/b][/h3]
Has been streamlined, with a new and improved UI and a new mission text box pop-up. Each type of mission will have its own icon. I currently have 2 modes coming in the next update: 'Last Stand', and a new mode called 'Conquest'. I currently have 7 modes planned in total; A tower defence style game mode, a base defence mode, 'Frontline', 'Last Stand', 'Survivors', 'Conquest' and a map exploration mode called 'Excursion'. Whether all of these will make it from concept to in-game will remain to be seen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541283/3a531981dfd0c67236b9ffe0a55c37c46c50a10f.png[/img]

[h3][b]See you on the battlefield soon![/b][/h3]

notes.title: A few things coming in the next update!
notes.content:
[b]Incoming message.[/b]
I know I have been a little quiet lately, and I haven't updated the game for a while, This is because the game is going to be heading in a new direction.

[u]A few things coming in the next update![/u]
[list]
[*]A new Blue UI:- This is to help people with colour blindness accessibility

[*]Less VRAM usage:- All textures and ships in the game have been reduced by 50% to help improve performance. 

[*]Improved! Elite Vanguard Academy:- The new Vanguard Academy will have Vanguard Ranks. The higher your rank the better elite skills you will have access too, there will also be multiple skills per rank and they will be free so you will no longer need to use Research Points to unlock them.

[*]Improved! Enemy AI:- Smarter AI that will now try to flank you. 

[*]Research Points:- will be removed and changed to Blueprint parts. All ships will now need 10 Blueprint parts to unlock ships. You can collect these from the new missions gameplay. You will also no longer need credits to unlock ships.    

[*]Missions:-  The current Battle-Meter formula will be changing to new and improved gameplay. More information at a later date.

[*]New music:- A new soundtrack has been added to the game. 

[*]New voice lines:- more chatter from crew and ship AI.
[/list]
[b]Notes:[/b]
Most of this update has been about Improved gameplay, increased accessibility, and increasing performance. Therefore this update has been no easy task to undertake.  For example reducing all the textures and ships by 50% also means I need to rebuild all the current levels. 

I was hoping to get this update out before new year, but it looks like it wont be till after

[b]See you on the battlefield soon Vanguards![/b]

notes.title: Cosmic Strike - The Last Sub Sector: Patch Notes 2.1.85
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes 2.1.85[/b]

[b]Intro: [/b]
The intro sequence on first boot has had some new improved artwork added. 

[b]UI:[/b]
While taking damage the Health bar will now flash red for a few seconds. 
The back button at the top left of the screen has be reworded to Exit. 
A new game mode menu has been added after clicking on the operations center.
The Shipyard now has a highlighted image/text when a ship is selected. 
Cinematic mode auto timer removed and a new button has been added to the UI.

[b]Enemies:[/b]
Red Arthropod now spawns little minions when killed. 
Emerald Arthropod health reduced from 32000 to 15000.
Aqua  Arthropod health reduced from 15000 to 8000
Some Arthropods will now only shoot if they have line of sight. 
Arthropods detection radius increased from 2000 to 6000. 
[b]
Ship balance:[/b]
The Player ships rotation speed , acceleration and rotation acceleration have been hugely increased (x4) to help improve playability. 
Super heavy fighter now has a aim assist while pressing right click. 

[b]Game modes - Last Stand :[/b]
Last stand game mode has been added to the game. 
This mode is wave after waves of enemies with increasing difficulty each wave with a total of 10 waves. There is currently 3 maps/arenas to choose from or try your luck with a random map. 

There will eventually be 3 enemies to choose from but currently only the Arthropods are available. This is to help test the game mode, and find bugs. But more importantly to help test all new and upcoming ships performance. I am hoping that all ships will be able to get to wave 10 without any crew,  modules or elite skills equipped.   
If you think a ship is underperforming report it to the steam forums or the official discord, and I will look into buffing it. 

During this update and future updates no ship will be nerfed unless it is 100% game breaking.

notes.title: Preview of the next update - Game Modes , Ships and balance changes.
notes.content:
[h1]Ships:[/h1]
30+ Ships will hopefully be coming in the next update depending on how much progress is made with new weapons and skills. 
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/813033010634293310/1136685469640425542/incoming.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/813033010634293310/1139517213808799844/shineys.png[/img]

[h1]Game Modes:[/h1]
when clicking on the operations centre you will now be taken to a new “Select a game mode” screen where there will be new and exciting modes to play.

 I am currently working on [b]Last Stand[/b] game mode where you will be pitted against wave after wave of enemies, victory bonus if you reach the last wave. At the moment there is no healing but I may have to put in a healing trait or able to heal at the station in-between waves of enemies.  

[b]Base defence[/b]: will possibly be like a MOBA where you have to defend the base and if the power core is destroyed its game over. 

[b]Tower defence:[/b] will be mixing base defence with last stand,  enemies will be coming from different paths/routes if the base is destroyed its game over. 

[b]Front line: [/b]A free for all death-match against AI mercenaries (this mode has currently been put on hold due to the AI not living up to expectations, I am currently looking at making a new AI or improving the current AI.)

[b]Survivors:[/b] Based on the current popular roguelike shoot 'em up/reverse bullet hell. (This mode needs a whole new trait system built)

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/813033010634293310/1145024177506615367/111.png[/img]

[h1]Balance changes:[/h1]
With the addition of the [b]Last Stand[/b] mode, I have been using it as a testing ground for the performance of ships. One of the most common complaints/feedback is the ships are too slow or hard to manoeuvrer.
 I have reduced the time it takes for a 360 spin from 10-12 seconds to only 6 seconds,  
ships can  now accelerate faster, but top seed of ships has not changed.  

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/813033010634293310/1145024229637623940/222.png[/img]
This is just what I have for now there will probably be more update at a later date depending on progress.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE COMING FOR COSMIC STRIKE
notes.content:
Hi Everyone 

Just posting an announcement for some of the big gameplay changes and updates coming to Cosmic Strike in the near future. 

Major Gameplay Changes: Introducing the Battle-meter
Previously you had to wander around the map to find and complete all the objectives to complete the mission. This would sometimes get quite tedious and tiresome.
 Therefore the new battle-meter mechanic has been introduced to help liven things up and keep things interesting. The meter starts off at 100% and any kill will deplete the meter by a set % amount. 
Once the meter has been depleted the faction boss will spawn, kill the boss to compete the mission. Different bosses will spawn depending on map difficulty.  

Because of the introduction of the battle-meter, all current primary objectives have been changed to secondary objectives. Completing the new and improved secondary objectives will now increase the battle-meter multiplier. 

 Increasing the battle-meter multiplier (maximum of x5) will deplete the meter faster meaning the boss will spawn faster. But completing the new and improved secondary objectives will also increase your mission credits reward by the same amount (maximum of x5). Therefore giving more incentive to go and complete the secondary objectives.   

The next major gameplay change I want to talk about is the new and improved Secondary Objectives. 

Current primary objectives vs New Secondary Objectives

1.FIND AND KILL THE 'GREEN' BOOGERS: - This is the same has not changed.

2.FIND AND DESTROY ALL THE MUTATED BOOGER NESTS:- This is the same has not changed.

3.  FIND AND CAPTURE THE AREA:-  Is now FIND AND CAPTURE THE GUN PLATFORM
Find the gun platform stay within the radius to bring it back online, the platform will then shoot any enemy within range. 

4. FIND AND RETRIEVE THE 10 POWERCORES: - Is now RETURN THE POWERCORE TO BRING THE MISSILE PLATFORM ONLINE.
Find and return the missing powercore to bring the missile platform online, once online the missiles will aim at any nearby enemy. Missiles will also go over obstacles unlike the gun platform.  

5.FIND AND KILL THE UNKNOWN 'WORM' BOOGER:  This is the same has not changed.

6.FIND AND DEFUSE THE BOMBS: - The bombs will now explode upon contact with the players ship dealing damage. However this will still count as a defuse. 

7. PLANT THE BOMB ON THE SPIKEY BOOGER: - Is now FIND AND ACTIVATE THE REPAIR STATION. Find the repair station stay within the radius to bring it back online, the station will then repair you when within range. 

8. FIND AND ESCORT THE 'DESTROYERS: - the aiming AI has been improved hugely the destroyers will now hit 90% of their targets, their damage has also been increased.  

9. FIND AND DEPLOY THE SATELLITE:- is now FIND THE MISSING PROTOTYPE TO BRING THE SHIELD ONLINE. Find the prototype return to the shield generator to bring the shield online. The shield will create a 360 degrees bubble that will block any enemy missile or projectile. Also any enemy that enters the shield will take damage. 

10. FIND AND PROTECT THE LOST SHIP:- The mechanics of the objective have been improved and the aiming AI has been improved.  

Some of new and improved Secondary Objectives are still subject to change before the next big update. There is still so much more to talk about in the next big update for Cosmic Strike, so stay tuned for future announcement and patch notes!

notes.title: Alpha 1.3.1
notes.content:
[b]Alpha 1.3.1[/b]

Base building:
Removed the power requirment from the main buildings (Shipyard, Crew Garrison, Modules facility).
Fixed a typo from; select a ship from the hangar,  to select a ship at the shipyard.
The Recreational Facilities no longer need the training academy as pre-requirement.
Reactors now have a maximum build limit of 4. 


Player Level up reward:
Flux disc (wheel spin) Tokens have been removed 
Research Points have been added with 1250RP per reward 

UI 
Logo and link to official Steam forums added. 
Logo and link to official discord added.
Act 1 title card has been updated 
Attack of the space booger title card has been updated

notes.title: Alpha 1.3.0
notes.content:
Cutscenes: 
Duration timer reduced from 8 to 6 seconds
Fade in timer reduced from 2 to 1 seconds 

Game Intro: 
Fixed a bug where, Intro sequence Part 8: 'Something on the radar' scene was skipped if the player was to quit and reload the game. 

Crew:
The crew, drag and drop functionality has changed from the Main profile image to the crew member card image. 
Therefore the crew tutorial is now out of date!

Base building:
Has had a total rework in functionality, the base now has a set layout and there are new 'build points' where the player can build, 1 of each building on each build point (excluding reactors). 
The edge of map line has been removed
The camera is now locked within a set area around the base and is no longer infinite.
The build cards now show the power icon next to the required power level.
 
Research Center:
Manufacture lore has been added to the research center.
Blueprints have been updated with ship descriptions, so the player will now have a better idea on how a ship is to be played. 

Shipyard:
The whole shipyard is now clickable to take you to the shipyard screen.

Player level up Reward: 
The player level up reward pop-up has been reduced in size and moved to the right of the screen, there is also a very short description on what the reward does.

notes.title: Alpha 1.2.07 is now live!
notes.content:
Cosmic Strike: 
Alpha 1.2.07 is now live!

Alpha 1.2

UI:
All of the UI has been replaced with new and improved assets, everything looks cleaner.

Cutscenes: 
Cutscenes have finally been added to the game in a Work in progress state, simple animations like panning, zooming, and rotations, will be added to them later on down the line.

Game Intro:
The game intro has been completely reworked into 9 sections with story elements added  

Part 1: Welcome to the vanguard fleet
Part 2: Name your profile 
Part 3: Select your character and custom mouse 
Part 4: Backstory to the game 
Part 5: Meet Europa
Part 6: Rendezvous with the main fleet 
Part 7: New Tutorial Mission
Part 8: Something on the radar 
Part 9: Welcome to Athena base

Story Character Selection:
There are currently 4 main characters to choose from, each with a small bio, artwork and unique voices. This character selection will hopefully effect some parts of the storyline at a later date.

Tutorial mission:
There is now a new tutorial mission tied into the story of the game. As you fly around the map text prompts will come up on the map and will tell you about a skill or function.
 It is up to you if you perform these actions, as before in the old tutorial you had to perform these actions else you could not progress. 

Base Building:
Out with the old overly complicated base building, and in with the new streamlined base building. 
A lot of the building have been upgraded visually. 

Base Building Menu: 
There is now 6 buildings in the centre of the base building map you will use these to get around, these building are the following; 

Living Quarters:- here you can see you player stats, redeem your drop pods, spin the fluxdisc (wheelspin), and see the compendium (wip)

Crew Garrison:- Unlock and equip crew that affect your ship.
Operations Centre:- Scan and search sub sectors for missions.
Research Centre:- Select and unlock ship blueprints.
Modules Facility:- Buy and equip modules for your ship.
Shipyard:- Buy and select ships.

There is also quick tabs in some of the rooms to help players navigate faster. 


Shipyard:
The shipyard has been improved visually and now displays the ships you have brought it will also display a ghost of a ship if you have the blueprint unlocked.  

Research Center: 
Has been added to the game where you will now have to unlock a blueprint using research points before you can buy the ship in the shipyard with credits.  

Modules Facility:
Has been added to the game so that players can now buy and equip modules to there ship. There are over 150 modules with 11 different stats for you to outfit your ship. Each module has up-to 2 Pre-Requirements for it to be unlocked.

Ships:
The Sentry has been added to the game with the following skills;
Left Click:- Burst Fire 
Right Click:- Rail rockets 
1:- Missiles 
2:- Mines 
3:- Movement boost

Ships FX:
All ships now have death and warp landing animations.

Loot Boxes: 
Have changed the previous system was to be similar to many RPGs with the following rarity; 
Common, Uncommon, Masterwork, Rare, Exotic, Ascended and Legendary.
The rarity system has been replaced with a 1-3 tier system. There is now a Credits, Loot Tokens, and Research Points pod for each tier. The higher the tier the better the reward.

Maps:
All the maps have had their height and width increased by 4000 this is to give a 2000 “buffer” zone around the map so that boogers & other AI no longer get stuck on parts of the map. The playable area still remains the same size.

Music:
The background battle music has changed to 3 albums By David KBD. This should give something for everyone.
Also pressing F8/F9 will cause the music to go backwards/forwards 1 track, this is so that if the random selection keeps selecting the same track you can change it to something you like

In-game UI:
Health bars on enemies are now gone to help keep the screen cleaner.
Instead when you mouse near enemies it will display the Name, min/max health, and a health bar at the top of the screen. The style of the health bar may change over time.

Those who have access to the game, happy bug hunting!
